'''Streamdrinker''' was a [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]]<ref name="WhoWhoTT" /> who, by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="StreamdrinkerArrest">"[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]" states that Streamdrinker was [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> had been selected by lottery to represent<ref name="WhoWhoTT" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="WhoWhoTT" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Chrono">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] implemented a [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|new system of regional governorship]]; in response, a group of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] dubbed the [[Delegation of 2000]] moved to protest the measures.<ref name="Newz" /> The inexperienced Streamdrinker joined the Delegation and his<ref name="WhoWhoTT" /> name was recorded on the [[Petition of 2000]], which was presented to the Republic Senate during its last session.<ref name="Newz" /> 

[[Standard day/Legends|Days]] later,<ref name="Chrono" /> after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Streamdrinker and sixty-two other senators of the Delegation were [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] by the newly-formed [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] on charges of conspiracy and [[Treason/Legends|treason]] in connection with an alleged [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] insurgency.<ref name="Newz" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Most of the politicians named in "63 Senators Arrested in Collusion with Jedi Insurgency" are newly-created, including Streamdrinker of Tynna (a personal indulgence since I like Tynnans).|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Blogg">{{Blog|danwallace|25|HoloNet News: The Annotated Edition}}</ref>}}
Streamdrinker was first mentioned in "[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]," an article written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. The article was featured in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Newz" /> which was released on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="InsiderWhen">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> Wallace admitted that he made Streamdrinker a Tynnan due to his fondness for the species.<ref name="Blogg" />
